cases.title: DK/FD singles scrapers die at import under run.py cwd=mlb_sgp
cases.note: Fix 07bf14bb sits on branch coverage-fix-singles-import, not on main.

expected_finding.failure: New `from mlb_sgp._shared import ...` while `Answer Keys/run.py` launches the singles scrapers with cwd=mlb_sgp and no PYTHONPATH, and those scripts import `dk_client` by script path -> ModuleNotFoundError at import, both singles scrapers dead.

`RestQuoteGateway.submit_quote` returns None on any non-2xx, non-dict, or id-less reply with status and body discarded and nothing logged -> the caller skips silently, a rejected quote leaves no decision row (17,653 of 17,964 priced RFQs placed nothing, 2026-08-18 to 09-02).

cases.title: Per-RFQ duckdb connect() in the discovery hot loop (#89)

expected_finding.failure: `_discovery_tick` opens two `db.connect(read_only=True)` per in-scope RFQ inside the loop at ~17 ms each -> pass time scales with open-RFQ count (8-12 s over ~200 RFQs), quotes reach 10 s-lifetime RFQs after they expire.

cases.title: $0 bets never dedup in bet_logger sheets.py
cases.note: Unfixed on main as of 2026-10-16; Cal asked for no code change when it was found (2026-09-15).

expected_finding.failure: `filter_duplicates` keys the amount as '' when `bet_amount` is 0 while `get_existing_bets` keys the same sheet row as `_normalize_amount(row[7])` = '0.00' -> a $0 (free-play) bet never matches its own row and is appended again on every run.

cases.title: Kalshi MM confirm tick leaves a 404 quote open forever

expected_finding.failure: `_confirm_tick`: `GET /communications/quotes/{qid}` returning 404 gives status None, which matches neither `accepted` nor the closed statuses -> the row stays `status='open'` forever and eats MAX_OPEN_QUOTES and both exposure caps until quoting stops.

cases.title: Bookmaker scraper writes a naive Pacific game time

expected_finding.failure: Bookmaker's Pacific `gmdt`/`gmtm` written as naive `game_date`/`game_time` VARCHAR with no timezone -> the R consumer reads them as Eastern, games within ~3 h of fetch look in progress and `.drop_past_games` silently drops about half the Bookmaker MLB rows.

cases.title: BFA open-bets clock offset fixed at +7 h off one February capture
cases.note: BFA also moved its clock between February and September; the catchable part is the fixed offset derived from a single fixture.

expected_finding.failure: `OPEN_BETS_CLOCK_OFFSET = timedelta(hours=7)` fixed for every season off one February capture while the same file's history parser reads DST-aware Pacific, and `SPORT_SUFFIX_RE` matches only the one-bracket form -> a September open bet gets placedAt 7 h early and an unstripped `[Sport:Football][League:NCAA]` description, so it misses the board.

cases.title: Bet105 poll has no fetch timeout, one hung request stalls it for good

expected_finding.failure: `pollBet105` sets `bet105Busy = true` then awaits `fetch` with no signal or timeout, and the reset is in `finally` -> one request that never settles leaves `bet105Busy` true and every later poll returns early (17 h stall, 2026-10-01/02).

cases.title: Novig counted as an independent book in the maker's 2-book quorum
cases.note: The commit message deferred the independence guard knowingly; the fix four months later was still a correctness fix for double counting.

expected_finding.failure: `MIN_AGREEING_BOOKS` 3 -> 2 while Novig relays DK/FD prices and is counted as its own book -> a DK+Novig flight passes the quorum on one source, double-weights that book in the median and shrinks sigma.
